name: _skeleton-utils.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  structure/_skeleton-utils.scss — global skeleton utilities — the shimmer/content-in keyframes and the .skeleton variant classes (pure CSS, no JS loop), plus the keyboard focus-ring emission.
//  Imported by _structure.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Global Skeleton Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────
@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

// Skeleton placeholder surface + shimmer — driven entirely by CSS (no JS loop; the old rAF version froze iOS).
.skeleton {
  &--shimmer,
  &-cover,
  &-placeholder {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--skel-bg-1);
    color: transparent;
    text-decoration: none;
    user-select: none;

    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      // Crisp sweep line — the broad gradient feathered the surface and
      // read as blur over the placeholder rows.
      background: linear-gradient(
        105deg,
        transparent 38%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 46%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 52%,
        transparent 60%
      );
      transform: translateX(-100%);
      animation: skeleton-shimmer 1.8s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  }

  &--title {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 45%;
    max-width: to-rem(480);
    height: to-rem(24);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);

    @include layout-768() {
      height: to-rem(36);
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      height: to-rem(56);
    }
  }

  &--hero {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    display: block;
  }

  &--media {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: to-rem(200);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    display: block;
  }

  &--text-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) 0;
  }

  &--text-line {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    height: to-rem(18);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);

    @include layout-768() {
      height: to-rem(21);
    }
  }

  &--tag {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem(110);
    height: to-rem(36);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &--title-sm {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: 35%;
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--title-md {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: 45%;
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--section-title {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 55%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-full {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 3);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-94 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 94%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-98 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 98%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 3);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-65 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 65%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--badge {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    height: to-rem($space-3xl);
    border-radius: 50%;
    margin: 0 to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &--footer-link {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-hairline);
  }

  &--footer-note-1 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 90%;
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-lg);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &--footer-note-2 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 75%;
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  // WebGL glyph field: absolutely-positioned overlay above the placeholders,
  // sized + translated inline by SkeletonWebGL. Content stays interactive.
  &-layer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;

    // While resolving, the incoming content owns the foreground: the layer
    // sinks below it so stale placeholder geometry never paints over real
    // data — the dissolve is only visible through still-transparent areas.
    &--resolving {
      z-index: -1;
    }
  }

  // Content arriving under a resolving layer fades in while glyphs collapse.
  // The class lands on the [data-content] wrapper (display: contents), so the
  // animation must target its children to be visible.
  &-content-in > * {
    animation: skeleton-content-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
}

// The canvas is a direct child of the shadow root: anchor its containing
// block to the host while a layer is active. The placeholders remain in flow
// so their geometry can still be measured, but become transparent because the
// WebGL canvas already paints those exact rectangles. Leaving the CSS shimmer
// visible underneath produces two superimposed skeleton animations everywhere.
:host(.has-skeleton-layer) {
  position: relative;
  // Confine the layer's stacking to this host so the resolving z-index: -1
  // drops under this component's content only — never behind page siblings.
  isolation: isolate;

  [data-content] [class*='skeleton'] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes skeleton-content-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// ── Keyboard focus ring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Emitted here so it lands in the document AND inside every component shadow
// root that imports this file — :focus-visible fires for keyboard focus only,
